highlights.title: Pick which bot fixes it
highlights.text: Each finding on a PR card says who Fix it goes to, like "Goes to Ana · lead of Edge". Press it to pick another bot of the space. Line notes work the same way.

highlights.title: Add your own documents to a space
highlights.text: Add .md, .txt or PDF files in Settings › This space › Documents, and bots quote them word for word. Only you can add or remove them. A quote's chip opens the passage.

highlights.title: Done cards check every part of what you asked
highlights.text: Leads cut your request into parts, in your words, and link each to its checks. A done card says "Partly checked" and names the part that has no check.

fixes: Download receipts under This week on the Mission board saves a CSV of finished tasks: who checked, how, the verdict and the evidence.
